# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 105 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 52 | Coptic

---

## Saying 105

Jesus said: "The one who knows father and mother will be called a bastard."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "A bastard" — renders the social accusation directly; being called a child of a harlot is equivalent to illegitimacy
- The social shame of the accusation is foregrounded
- The saying is deliberately compressed to its sharpest point
